text.en_us: Right-click to toggle between on and off, and it stays in that state
text.zh_cn: 右键在开与关之间切换并保持该状态

text.en_us: While on, emits a redstone signal of strength 15
text.zh_cn: 开启时输出强度 15 的红石信号

text.en_us: Can be placed on any solid face of a block
text.zh_cn: 可附着在方块的任意固体面上

text.en_us: Responds only to right-clicks and detects nothing else
text.zh_cn: 只响应右键，不检测其他任何变化

text.en_us: Continuously emits a redstone signal of strength 15
text.zh_cn: 持续输出强度 15 的红石信号

text.en_us: Turns off while the block it is attached to is powered
text.zh_cn: 所附着的方块被充能时熄灭

text.en_us: Toggled on and off 8 or more times within 60 ticks, it burns out and stays off for a while
text.zh_cn: 在 60 游戏刻内被切换 8 次及以上会烧毁并暂时熄灭

text.en_us: Also lights the area like a torch
text.zh_cn: 同时像火把一样提供照明

text.en_us: Re-emits its input at full strength 15
text.zh_cn: 把输入信号以满强度 15 重新输出

text.en_us: Right-click to set a delay of 1 to 4 redstone ticks (0.1 to 0.4 s)
text.zh_cn: 右键设置 1~4 红石刻（0.1~0.4 秒）的延迟

text.en_us: Passes signals in one direction only
text.zh_cn: 信号只能单向通过

text.en_us: Cannot take input from its sides
text.zh_cn: 不从两侧接收输入

text.en_us: Locked while a repeater or comparator faces into its side
text.zh_cn: 被朝向其侧面的中继器或比较器锁定时保持当前状态

text.en_us: Compares two inputs and outputs the difference
text.zh_cn: 比较两个输入并输出其差值

text.en_us: Reads container fill levels, cauldron levels, jukebox discs and block states
text.zh_cn: 可读取容器填充度、炼药锅液面、唱片机唱片与方块状态

text.en_us: Right-click cycles compare and subtract modes, and toggles the front torch
text.zh_cn: 右键在比较模式与减法模式间切换，并点亮或熄灭前端火把

text.en_us: Output strength 0-15
text.zh_cn: 输出信号强度 0~15

text.en_us: The lit front torch means subtract mode is active
text.zh_cn: 前端火把点亮时处于减法模式

text.en_us: Carries power up to 15 blocks, losing 1 strength per block
text.zh_cn: 可传输至多 15 格，每格损失 1 点强度

text.en_us: Connects to most redstone components
text.zh_cn: 可连接绝大多数红石元件

text.en_us: Loses an extra point of strength when travelling upward
text.zh_cn: 向上传输时强度额外衰减

text.en_us: Cannot climb more than one block
text.zh_cn: 向上的爬升高度不能超过一格

text.en_us: Breaks instantly and drops redstone dust
text.zh_cn: 被破坏时立即掉落红石粉

text.en_us: Acts as a permanent power source of strength 15 in all directions
text.zh_cn: 作为永久电源向所有方向输出强度 15 的信号

text.en_us: Made from 9 redstone dust
text.zh_cn: 由 9 个红石粉合成

text.en_us: Cannot be turned off
text.zh_cn: 无法被关闭

text.en_us: Lights up while it receives redstone power
text.zh_cn: 被充能时点亮

text.en_us: Stays lit for 4 ticks after power is removed
text.zh_cn: 失去充能后仍保持点亮 4 游戏刻

text.en_us: Can be toggled rapidly by redstone pulses
text.zh_cn: 可用红石脉冲快速反复切换

text.en_us: Emits light level 15 while lit
text.zh_cn: 点亮时发光等级为 15

text.en_us: When powered, pushes up to 12 blocks one block forward
text.zh_cn: 被充能时把至多 12 个方块向前推动一格

text.en_us: Cannot push obsidian, bedrock or blocks with block entities
text.zh_cn: 无法推动黑曜石、基岩以及带有方块实体的方块

text.en_us: Cannot pull blocks back
text.zh_cn: 不能把方块拉回

text.en_us: Loses its head if the pushed block cannot move
text.zh_cn: 被推动的方块无法移动时活塞头消失

text.en_us: Pushes blocks forward when powered and pulls the block back when unpowered
text.zh_cn: 被充能时推动方块，断电时把方块拉回

text.en_us: Slime blocks and honey blocks stick to it
text.zh_cn: 粘液块与蜂蜜块会粘附在其上

text.en_us: Pulling fails for immovable blocks, but the head still retracts
text.zh_cn: 无法拉动不可移动的方块，但活塞头仍会收回

text.en_us: Pulls at most 12 blocks in one move
text.zh_cn: 一次最多拉动 12 个方块

text.en_us: Detects a block state change in the block it faces
text.zh_cn: 检测其面对方块的状态变化

text.en_us: Emits a 1-tick pulse from its back
text.zh_cn: 从背面输出 1 游戏刻的脉冲

text.en_us: The face with the dot is the output face
text.zh_cn: 带圆点的面是输出面

text.en_us: Detects changes such as crop growth, block placement and block breaking
text.zh_cn: 可检测作物生长、方块放置与方块破坏等变化

text.en_us: When powered, ejects its contents as entities or uses them
text.zh_cn: 被充能时把内部物品作为实体射出或直接使用

text.en_us: Uses arrows, fire charges, water and lava buckets, bone meal, shears, armor for armor stands, TNT and more
text.zh_cn: 可使用箭、火焰弹、水桶与熔岩桶、骨粉、剪刀、盔甲架装备、TNT 等

text.en_us: Has 9 inventory slots
text.zh_cn: 拥有 9 个物品槽

text.en_us: Right-click to open it and fill the slots
text.zh_cn: 右键打开并装填物品

text.en_us: When powered, drops one item as an item entity instead of using it
text.zh_cn: 被充能时把物品作为掉落物投出，而不使用它

text.en_us: Transfers items into the container it faces
text.zh_cn: 会把物品送入其面对的容器

text.en_us: Has 9 inventory slots
text.zh_cn: 拥有 9 个物品槽

text.en_us: Fires only one item per redstone pulse
text.zh_cn: 每个红石脉冲只投出一个物品

text.en_us: Collects item entities above it and pulls items from the container above
text.zh_cn: 收集其上方的掉落物，并从上方容器中吸取物品

text.en_us: Moves one item every 4 redstone ticks (0.4 s) into the container it points into
text.zh_cn: 每 4 红石刻（0.4 秒）向指向的容器转移一个物品

text.en_us: Disabled while it receives redstone power
text.zh_cn: 被充能时停止工作

text.en_us: A comparator reads its contents
text.zh_cn: 比较器可读取其内部物品数量

text.en_us: Pulls only from the block directly above, not from the sides
text.zh_cn: 只从正上方吸取，不从两侧吸取

text.en_us: Right-click to change the pitch, with 25 pitches over 2 octaves
text.zh_cn: 右键调整音高，两个八度共 25 个音高

text.en_us: Plays a note when powered or when the block above it changes
text.zh_cn: 被充能或其上方方块变化时发声

text.en_us: The sound depends on the block below it
text.zh_cn: 音色取决于其下方的方块

text.en_us: Air below makes a harp sound
text.zh_cn: 下方为空气时发出竖琴音色

text.en_us: Right-click with a music disc to insert it and play it
text.zh_cn: 手持音乐唱片右键放入并播放

text.en_us: Emits a redstone signal whose strength identifies the disc
text.zh_cn: 输出红石信号，强度对应所播放的唱片

text.en_us: Right-click again to remove the disc, or use a hopper
text.zh_cn: 再次右键取出唱片，也可用漏斗取出

text.en_us: The music is heard by everyone in the area
text.zh_cn: 附近所有玩家都能听到音乐

text.en_us: Emits power based on sunlight, from 0 to 15, peaking at noon
text.zh_cn: 根据日照强度输出 0~15 的红石信号，正午最强

text.en_us: Right-click to invert it, so it outputs 15 at night
text.zh_cn: 右键切换为夜间模式，夜间输出 15

text.en_us: Unaffected by moonlight in normal mode
text.zh_cn: 普通模式不受月光影响

text.en_us: Output is reduced by rain and thunderstorms
text.zh_cn: 降雨与雷暴会降低其输出

text.en_us: Emits a redstone signal for 4 ticks when hit by a projectile
text.zh_cn: 被弹射物击中时输出 4 游戏刻的红石信号

text.en_us: The strength depends on how close to the centre it was hit, from 1 to 15
text.zh_cn: 信号强度取决于命中点距中心的距离，范围为 1~15

text.en_us: A hit on the centre gives strength 15
text.zh_cn: 命中正中心时强度为 15

text.en_us: A hit near the edge gives strength 1
text.zh_cn: 命中边缘附近时强度为 1

text.en_us: Placed on both sides with string between them forms a tripwire
text.zh_cn: 两侧各放一个钩并以线相连即构成绊线

text.en_us: Emits power while an entity or player crosses the string
text.zh_cn: 实体或玩家穿过线时输出红石信号

text.en_us: The signal strength decreases with distance from the hook
text.zh_cn: 信号强度随距钩的距离递减

text.en_us: Breaking the string triggers it once
text.zh_cn: 线被破坏时也会触发一次

text.en_us: String stretched between two tripwire hooks
text.zh_cn: 拉紧在两个绊线钩之间的线

text.en_us: An entity or player crossing it makes the hooks emit power
text.zh_cn: 实体或玩家穿过时使绊线钩输出红石信号

text.en_us: Shears cut the string and trigger the trap once
text.zh_cn: 用剪刀剪断线也会触发一次

text.en_us: Placed on the ground without hooks, the string is decorative and detects nothing
text.zh_cn: 未连接绊线钩时线只作装饰，不会检测任何东西

text.en_us: Speeds up a minecart while powered by redstone
text.zh_cn: 被红石充能时加速其上的矿车

text.en_us: A single powered rail can push a minecart several blocks
text.zh_cn: 单个充能铁轨即可把矿车推动数格

text.en_us: Unpowered, it brakes a moving minecart
text.zh_cn: 未充能时会减缓矿车的移动

text.en_us: Can be placed on slopes and curves
text.zh_cn: 可铺设成斜坡与弯道

text.en_us: While powered, ejects entities riding a minecart
text.zh_cn: 被充能时弹出乘坐矿车的实体

text.en_us: Disables a hopper minecart or a TNT minecart while powered
text.zh_cn: 被充能时禁用漏斗矿车与 TNT 矿车

text.en_us: Ignites a TNT minecart that passes over it while powered
text.zh_cn: 被充能时点燃经过其上的 TNT 矿车

text.en_us: Does nothing while unpowered
text.zh_cn: 未充能时不产生任何效果

text.en_us: Emits a redstone signal while a minecart is on it
text.zh_cn: 矿车在其上时输出红石信号

text.en_us: A hopper or chest minecart on it can be read by a comparator
text.zh_cn: 其上的漏斗矿车或箱子矿车可被比较器读取

text.en_us: Any minecart, including empty ones, triggers it
text.zh_cn: 任何矿车包括空矿车都会触发

text.en_us: Does not power the rail itself or the rails next to it
text.zh_cn: 不会给自身或相邻铁轨充能

text.en_us: A plain rail that guides a minecart, and can be laid as curves and slopes
text.zh_cn: 引导矿车行驶的普通铁轨，可铺设成弯道与斜坡

text.en_us: Cannot be powered and never accelerates a minecart
text.zh_cn: 不能被充能，也不会加速矿车

text.en_us: Placed on a slope, it lets a minecart change height by one block
text.zh_cn: 铺成斜坡时可让矿车升降一格

text.en_us: A minecart on flat rails slowly loses speed to friction
text.zh_cn: 矿车在平地铁轨上会因摩擦缓慢减速

text.en_us: Primed by flint and steel, a fire charge, redstone power or fire
text.zh_cn: 可用打火石、火焰弹、红石信号或火点燃

text.en_us: Explodes after 80 ticks, about 4 seconds
text.zh_cn: 点燃后约 80 游戏刻即 4 秒后爆炸

text.en_us: Can be pushed by pistons
text.zh_cn: 可被活塞推动

text.en_us: An explosion underwater deals reduced damage to entities
text.zh_cn: 水下爆炸对实体造成的伤害降低

text.en_us: Destroys most blocks in its blast radius
text.zh_cn: 会摧毁爆炸范围内的绝大多数方块

text.en_us: Detects vibrations within 8 blocks and emits a redstone signal
text.zh_cn: 检测 8 格内的振动并输出红石信号

text.en_us: The signal lasts as long as the vibration's frequency
text.zh_cn: 信号持续时间与振动的频率对应

text.en_us: Does not detect a sneaking player
text.zh_cn: 不会检测潜行中的玩家

text.en_us: Can be waterlogged
text.zh_cn: 可以含水

text.en_us: The frequency depends on the type of vibration
text.zh_cn: 频率取决于振动的种类

text.en_us: Reads the strongest vibration on one of its input faces
text.zh_cn: 读取其各输入面上最强的振动

text.en_us: Outputs a signal proportional to the vibration frequency
text.zh_cn: 输出的信号强度与振动频率成正比

text.en_us: Redstone input on the back filters for that exact frequency
text.zh_cn: 背面输入的红石信号用于过滤指定频率，只保留该强度的振动

text.en_us: Its range is twice as far and its signal is stronger than a sculk sensor
text.zh_cn: 检测范围为幽匿感测体的两倍，信号也更强

text.en_us: Shrieks when a player triggers a nearby sculk sensor or steps on it
text.zh_cn: 附近幽匿感测体被触发或玩家踩踏时尖啸

text.en_us: Shrieking inflicts Darkness and eventually spawns a Warden
text.zh_cn: 尖啸会施加黑暗效果，多次尖啸后生成监守者

text.en_us: Only shriekers naturally generated in the Deep Dark can summon Wardens
text.zh_cn: 只有深暗之域中自然生成的尖啸体才能召唤监守者

text.en_us: Can also be activated by a redstone signal
text.zh_cn: 也可由红石信号直接激活

text.en_us: Converts mob deaths within 8 blocks into sculk
text.zh_cn: 把 8 格内生物死亡转化为幽匿

text.en_us: Blooms with a ring of sculk, spreading sculk veins, sensors and shriekers
text.zh_cn: 以幽匿环绽放，并生成幽匿脉络、感测体与尖啸体

text.en_us: The experience from the kill fuels the spread
text.zh_cn: 由击杀产生的经验推动扩散

text.en_us: Gives experience when mined without Silk Touch
text.zh_cn: 不用精准采集挖掘时会掉落经验

text.en_us: Generated by a sculk catalyst and spread from mob deaths
text.zh_cn: 由幽匿催发体生成，并随生物死亡扩散

text.en_us: Mined with Silk Touch it drops itself, otherwise it drops experience
text.zh_cn: 用精准采集挖掘掉落自身，否则掉落经验

text.en_us: Found in the Deep Dark
text.zh_cn: 生成于深暗之域

text.en_us: Sculk blocks can be used as decoration or fuel for a catalyst
text.zh_cn: 幽匿方块可用作装饰或催化体的传播载体

text.en_us: The thin decorative variant of sculk that grows on block faces
text.zh_cn: 附着在方块表面的薄层幽匿装饰变体

text.en_us: Mined with Silk Touch it drops itself, otherwise it drops experience
text.zh_cn: 用精准采集挖掘掉落自身，否则掉落经验

text.en_us: Spreads from a sculk catalyst when mobs die nearby
text.zh_cn: 附近生物死亡时由幽匿催发体扩散生成

text.en_us: Can be placed on any solid face
text.zh_cn: 可附着在任意固体面上

text.en_us: Attracts lightning strikes within a 128-block radius during thunderstorms
text.zh_cn: 雷暴期间吸引 128 格范围内的闪电并引导至自身

text.en_us: Emits a redstone signal for 8 ticks when struck
text.zh_cn: 被雷击时输出 8 游戏刻的红石信号

text.en_us: Made of copper
text.zh_cn: 由铜制成

text.en_us: Can be placed on any face
text.zh_cn: 可附着在任意面

text.en_us: Emits a 1-second pulse, 10 redstone ticks, when pressed by hand
text.zh_cn: 被手按下时输出 1 秒即 10 红石刻的脉冲

text.en_us: Hit by an arrow, it emits a longer pulse
text.zh_cn: 被箭射中时输出更长的脉冲

text.en_us: Pulse length from an arrow depends on how long the arrow stays in the button
text.zh_cn: 箭矢产生的脉冲长度取决于其插在按钮上的时间

text.en_us: Can be placed on the floor, ceiling or a wall
text.zh_cn: 可放置在地面、天花板或墙面上

text.en_us: Emits a 1-second pulse, 10 redstone ticks, when pressed by hand
text.zh_cn: 被手按下时输出 1 秒即 10 红石刻的脉冲

text.en_us: Hit by an arrow, it emits a longer pulse
text.zh_cn: 被箭射中时输出更长的脉冲

text.en_us: Pulse length from an arrow depends on how long the arrow stays in the button
text.zh_cn: 箭矢产生的脉冲长度取决于其插在按钮上的时间

text.en_us: Can be placed on the floor, ceiling or a wall
text.zh_cn: 可放置在地面、天花板或墙面上

text.en_us: Emits power of strength 15 while a mob or player stands on it
text.zh_cn: 生物或玩家踩在其上时输出强度 15 的红石信号

text.en_us: Items dropped on it do not trigger it
text.zh_cn: 掉落的物品不会触发它

text.en_us: Also triggered by arrows and other projectiles
text.zh_cn: 也会被箭等弹射物触发

text.en_us: Turns off as soon as the entity steps off
text.zh_cn: 实体离开后立即停止输出

text.en_us: Emits power of strength 15 while a mob or player stands on it
text.zh_cn: 生物或玩家踩在其上时输出强度 15 的红石信号

text.en_us: Items dropped on it do not trigger it
text.zh_cn: 掉落的物品不会触发它

text.en_us: Also triggered by arrows and other projectiles
text.zh_cn: 也会被箭等弹射物触发

text.en_us: Turns off as soon as the entity steps off
text.zh_cn: 实体离开后立即停止输出

text.en_us: Its signal strength equals the number of entities on it, up to 15
text.zh_cn: 信号强度等于其上实体的数量，最高 15

text.en_us: Usually made of gold, so it reacts to a single entity
text.zh_cn: 通常由金制成，因此对单个实体就会响应

text.en_us: Dropped items on it are also counted
text.zh_cn: 其上的掉落物也会被计入数量

text.en_us: Useful for counting entities in a small area
text.zh_cn: 适合用于统计小范围内的实体数量

text.en_us: Its signal strength equals the number of entities on it divided by 10, up to 15
text.zh_cn: 信号强度等于其上实体数量除以 10，最高 15

text.en_us: Usually made of iron, so every 10 entities add 1 strength
text.zh_cn: 通常由铁制成，每 10 个实体增加 1 点强度

text.en_us: Dropped items on it are also counted
text.zh_cn: 其上的掉落物也会被计入数量

text.en_us: A single entity is not enough to produce a signal
text.zh_cn: 单个实体不足以产生信号

text.en_us: Placed on the ground as redstone wire, it carries redstone signals
text.zh_cn: 放置后成为红石线，用于传输红石信号

text.en_us: Also used as a crafting ingredient for many redstone components
text.zh_cn: 也是多种红石元件的合成材料

text.en_us: Mined from redstone ore, or from deepslate redstone ore
text.zh_cn: 由红石矿石或深层红石矿石开采获得

text.en_us: Also brews potions of Healing and extends other potions
text.zh_cn: 还可用于酿造治疗药水或延长其他药水

text.en_us: Right-click to shoot a small fireball
text.zh_cn: 右键发射一枚小火球

text.en_us: Ignites the block it hits, and can light a nether portal
text.zh_cn: 点燃命中的方块，也可点燃下界传送门

text.en_us: A dispenser loaded with fire charges shoots them
text.zh_cn: 装填在发射器中会被射出

text.en_us: Can prime TNT
text.zh_cn: 可以点燃 TNT

text.en_us: Right-click to launch it
text.zh_cn: 右键发射

text.en_us: With no explosion it boosts elytra flight instead
text.zh_cn: 不含爆炸效果时用于为鞘翅飞行提供加速

text.en_us: Crafted with a firework star, it explodes and deals damage
text.zh_cn: 加入烟花之星后会爆炸并造成伤害

text.en_us: More gunpowder extends the flight duration
text.zh_cn: 增加火药可延长飞行时间

text.en_us: Fired from a crossbow, it flies in a straight line
text.zh_cn: 由弩发射时会沿直线飞行

text.en_us: A minecart loaded with TNT that explodes after being primed
text.zh_cn: 装载 TNT 的矿车，被点燃后爆炸

text.en_us: Primed by an activator rail, by fire or by a redstone signal
text.zh_cn: 可由激活铁轨、火焰或红石信号点燃

text.en_us: Falls if the rail under it is removed, and explodes on impact
text.zh_cn: 下方铁轨被破坏后会坠落，落地即爆炸

text.en_us: Can be pushed by pistons before it is primed
text.zh_cn: 未被点燃时可被活塞推动

text.en_us: Opens a 3x3 grid for arranging a recipe and crafting items
text.zh_cn: 打开3×3的合成网格，摆放配方以合成物品

text.en_us: Includes a recipe book that can fill in unlocked recipes
text.zh_cn: 内置配方书，可一键填充已解锁的配方

text.en_us: Note: with JEI installed, hover an item and press R for recipes or U for uses
text.zh_cn: 注：安装JEI后，鼠标悬停物品并按R查看配方、按U查看用途

text.en_us: Smelts items using fuel, taking 10 seconds per item
text.zh_cn: 消耗燃料熔炼物品，每件耗时10秒

text.en_us: Consumes one unit of fuel per operation
text.zh_cn: 每次操作消耗一份燃料

text.en_us: Smelts ores, tools and armor only
text.zh_cn: 仅能熔炼矿石、工具与盔甲

text.en_us: Smelts twice as fast as a furnace, 5 seconds per item
text.zh_cn: 熔炼速度为熔炉的两倍，每件耗时5秒

text.en_us: Each unit of fuel lasts for twice as many items
text.zh_cn: 每份燃料可熔炼的物品数量翻倍

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Armorer villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为盔甲匠的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Cooks food only
text.zh_cn: 仅能烹饪食物

text.en_us: Cooks twice as fast as a furnace, 5 seconds per item
text.zh_cn: 烹饪速度为熔炉的两倍，每件耗时5秒

text.en_us: Each unit of fuel lasts for twice as many items
text.zh_cn: 每份燃料可烹饪的食物数量翻倍

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Butcher villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为屠夫的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Cuts stone blocks into stairs, slabs and other variants
text.zh_cn: 将石头类方块切割为楼梯、台阶等变体

text.en_us: One input yields one output with no waste
text.zh_cn: 一份材料产出一份成品，不产生损耗

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Mason villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为石匠的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Applies banner patterns to a banner
text.zh_cn: 可将旗帜图案应用到旗帜上

text.en_us: The dye placed in the loom colors the pattern
text.zh_cn: 放入织布机的染料决定图案的颜色

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Shepherd villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为牧羊人的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Zooms out, copies and locks maps
text.zh_cn: 可缩放、复制与锁定地图

text.en_us: Paper zooms a map out, an empty map copies it, a glass pane locks it
text.zh_cn: 地图加纸可缩小比例，加空地图可复制，加玻璃板可锁定

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Cartographer villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为制图师的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Currently has no interface and cannot craft arrows directly
text.zh_cn: 目前没有交互界面，无法直接用来制作箭

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Fletcher villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为制箭师的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Applies armor trims and netherite upgrades
text.zh_cn: 可应用盔甲纹饰与下界合金升级

text.en_us: Each recipe needs a smithing template and the matching material
text.zh_cn: 每次升级需要锻造模板与对应材料

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Toolsmith villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为工具匠的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Repairs items and removes their enchantments
text.zh_cn: 可修复物品耐久，也可移除其附魔

text.en_us: Removing enchantments returns some experience
text.zh_cn: 移除附魔时会返还部分经验

text.en_us: Cannot remove curses
text.zh_cn: 无法移除绑定诅咒与消失诅咒

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Weaponsmith villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为武器匠的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Renames items, repairs them with materials and combines enchantments
text.zh_cn: 可为物品重命名、用材料修复并合并附魔

text.en_us: Degrades with each use across 3 damage states
text.zh_cn: 每次使用都会损耗，共有3种损坏状态

text.en_us: A falling anvil hurts entities below
text.zh_cn: 从高处掉落的铁砧会砸伤下方实体

text.en_us: Cannot be pushed by pistons
text.zh_cn: 无法被活塞推动

text.en_us: An anvil in the last damage state is destroyed when used
text.zh_cn: 处于第三损坏阶段的铁砧再次使用会被摧毁

text.en_us: Works like an anvil but is already in its second damage state
text.zh_cn: 用途与铁砧相同，但已处于第二损坏阶段

text.en_us: Renames items, repairs them with materials and combines enchantments
text.zh_cn: 可为物品重命名、用材料修复并合并附魔

text.en_us: A falling anvil hurts entities below
text.zh_cn: 从高处掉落的铁砧会砸伤下方实体

text.en_us: Each use may damage it further, until it is destroyed
text.zh_cn: 每次使用都可能加深损坏，最终会被摧毁

text.en_us: Works like an anvil but is already in its final damage state
text.zh_cn: 用途与铁砧相同，但已处于第三损坏阶段

text.en_us: Renames items, repairs them with materials and combines enchantments
text.zh_cn: 可为物品重命名、用材料修复并合并附魔

text.en_us: A falling anvil hurts entities below
text.zh_cn: 从高处掉落的铁砧会砸伤下方实体

text.en_us: Using it again has a chance to destroy it
text.zh_cn: 再次使用有几率将其摧毁

text.en_us: Enchants one item by spending experience levels and lapis lazuli
text.zh_cn: 消耗经验等级与青金石为物品附魔

text.en_us: Offers 3 options; the number on the right is the required level
text.zh_cn: 每次提供3个选项，右侧数字为所需等级

text.en_us: Bookshelves placed around it raise the maximum level to 30
text.zh_cn: 周围摆放书架可将可选等级上限提升至30级

text.en_us: Only 15 bookshelves near the table are counted
text.zh_cn: 只有附魔台附近15个书架会被计入

text.en_us: One block of air must remain between a bookshelf and the table
text.zh_cn: 书架与附魔台之间需空出一格

text.en_us: The three options cost 1, 2 and 3 lapis lazuli
text.zh_cn: 三个选项分别消耗1、2、3个青金石

text.en_us: Raises the maximum enchantment level of a nearby enchanting table
text.zh_cn: 摆放于附魔台附近可提升其最大附魔等级

text.en_us: Drops 3 books when mined without Silk Touch
text.zh_cn: 不使用精准采集破坏时掉落3本书

text.en_us: One block of air must remain between it and the table
text.zh_cn: 与附魔台之间需空出一格

text.en_us: Stores up to 6 books of any kind
text.zh_cn: 可存放6本任意种类的书

text.en_us: A redstone comparator reads how full it is
text.zh_cn: 红石比较器可读取其装满程度

text.en_us: Hoppers can insert books into it and extract them
text.zh_cn: 漏斗可向其中存入或从中取出书

text.en_us: Holds a book and quill or a written book so several players can read it
text.zh_cn: 可放置书与笔或成书，供多名玩家共同阅读

text.en_us: Turning a page emits a redstone pulse
text.zh_cn: 翻页时会输出一次红石脉冲

text.en_us: A comparator's output reflects the current page
text.zh_cn: 红石比较器的输出强度随当前页码变化

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Librarian villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为图书管理员的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Converts compostable items into bone meal
text.zh_cn: 将可堆肥物品转化为骨粉

text.en_us: Produces bone meal once 7 layers are filled
text.zh_cn: 填满7层后产出骨粉

text.en_us: A comparator reads the fill level
text.zh_cn: 红石比较器可读取其填充层数

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Farmer villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为农民的工作站点方块

text.en_us: A storage block that can still be opened with a block above it
text.zh_cn: 存储方块，上方有方块阻挡时仍可打开

text.en_us: Its lid opens with an animation
text.zh_cn: 打开时盖子会有开合动画

text.en_us: Its open state can be detected by an observer
text.zh_cn: 开启状态可被侦测器检测到

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Fisherman villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为渔夫的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Brews potions using blaze powder as fuel
text.zh_cn: 以烈焰粉为燃料酿造药水

text.en_us: Each operation uses one ingredient and processes up to 3 bottles
text.zh_cn: 每次操作消耗一份材料，可同时处理3个瓶子

text.en_us: Right-click with a water bottle to fill one of its bottle slots
text.zh_cn: 手持水瓶右键可为酿造台装水

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Cleric villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为牧师的工作站点方块

text.en_us: Holds 1 to 3 layers of water, lava or powder snow
text.zh_cn: 可盛放1~3层水、熔岩或细雪

text.en_us: Filled by right-clicking with the matching bucket
text.zh_cn: 手持对应的桶右键即可填充

text.en_us: Rain or dripstone above slowly fills it
text.zh_cn: 降雨或上方滴水石会缓慢将其填充

text.en_us: A glass bottle can be filled from the water it holds
text.zh_cn: 可用玻璃瓶从中装水

text.en_us: Serves as the job site block for Leatherworker villagers
text.zh_cn: 可作为皮匠的工作站点方块

text.en_us: A cauldron holding 1 to 3 layers of water
text.zh_cn: 盛有1~3层水的炼药锅

text.en_us: Washes the dye off leather armor and banners
text.zh_cn: 可洗去皮革盔甲与旗帜上的染料

text.en_us: Fills a glass bottle with water, using up one layer
text.zh_cn: 可用玻璃瓶装水，每次消耗1层

text.en_us: Extinguishes fire on entities
text.zh_cn: 可使着火实体身上的火熄灭

text.en_us: Slowly refilled by rain or dripstone above
text.zh_cn: 降雨或上方滴水石会缓慢填充

text.en_us: A cauldron holding 1 to 3 layers of lava
text.zh_cn: 盛有1~3层熔岩的炼药锅

text.en_us: Damages entities that touch the lava
text.zh_cn: 接触其中熔岩的实体持续受到伤害

text.en_us: Emits light
text.zh_cn: 可作为光源

text.en_us: Filled by lava dripping from pointed dripstone above
text.zh_cn: 上方滴水石滴落的熔岩会将其填充

text.en_us: A cauldron holding 1 to 3 layers of powder snow
text.zh_cn: 盛有1~3层细雪的炼药锅

text.en_us: An empty bucket can be filled from it
text.zh_cn: 可用空桶从中装取细雪

text.en_us: Extinguishes fire on entities
text.zh_cn: 可使着火实体身上的火熄灭

text.en_us: Entities that fall in sink and freeze
text.zh_cn: 陷入其中的实体持续受到冰冻伤害

text.en_us: Cooks up to 4 food items at once without any fuel
text.zh_cn: 无需燃料，可同时烹饪4份食物

text.en_us: Right-click with food to place it on the fire
text.zh_cn: 手持食物右键即可放上营火

text.en_us: Entities standing on it take fire damage
text.zh_cn: 站在其上的实体持续受到火焰伤害

text.en_us: Also serves as a light source and a smoke signal
text.zh_cn: 可作为光源与烟雾信号源

text.en_us: A hay bale placed below makes the smoke rise higher
text.zh_cn: 下方放置干草捆可使烟雾升得更高

text.en_us: Extinguished with a shovel or water, relit with flint and steel
text.zh_cn: 用锹或水可扑灭，用打火石可重新点燃

text.en_us: Burns with blue soul fire and cooks 4 food items without fuel
text.zh_cn: 燃烧蓝色灵魂火，无需燃料即可烹饪4份食物

text.en_us: Crafted with soul soil or soul sand instead of logs
text.zh_cn: 用灵魂土或灵魂沙代替原木合成

text.en_us: Deals more damage than a normal campfire
text.zh_cn: 造成的伤害高于普通营火

text.en_us: Emits a dimmer light than a normal campfire
text.zh_cn: 光照强度低于普通营火

text.en_us: Extinguished with a shovel or water, relit with flint and steel
text.zh_cn: 用锹或水可扑灭，用打火石可重新点燃

text.en_us: Houses up to 3 bees
text.zh_cn: 最多可容纳3只蜜蜂

text.en_us: Shearing a full nest yields 3 honeycomb, a glass bottle yields a honey bottle
text.zh_cn: 对满的蜂巢使用剪刀可获得3个蜜脾，使用玻璃瓶可获得蜂蜜瓶

text.en_us: Generates naturally on trees in some biomes
text.zh_cn: 自然生成于部分生物群系的树木上

text.en_us: A campfire placed below keeps the bees calm
text.zh_cn: 在下方放置营火可使蜜蜂不被激怒

text.en_us: A comparator reads how full it is
text.zh_cn: 红石比较器可读取其蜂蜜储量

text.en_us: Silk Touch keeps the bees inside when it is moved
text.zh_cn: 使用精准采集破坏可保留其中的蜜蜂

text.en_us: A crafted hive that houses up to 3 bees
text.zh_cn: 可合成的蜂箱，最多容纳3只蜜蜂

text.en_us: Shearing a full hive yields 3 honeycomb, a glass bottle yields a honey bottle
text.zh_cn: 对满的蜂箱使用剪刀可获得3个蜜脾，使用玻璃瓶可获得蜂蜜瓶

text.en_us: A campfire placed below keeps the bees calm
text.zh_cn: 在下方放置营火可使蜜蜂不被激怒

text.en_us: A comparator reads how full it is
text.zh_cn: 红石比较器可读取其蜂蜜储量

text.en_us: Silk Touch keeps the bees inside when it is moved
text.zh_cn: 使用精准采集破坏可保留其中的蜜蜂

text.en_us: Personal storage shared between all ender chests of one player
text.zh_cn: 同一玩家的所有末影箱共享同一份存储空间

text.en_us: Contents are kept per player and survive death
text.zh_cn: 箱内物品按玩家独立保存，死亡后也不会丢失

text.en_us: Breaking it without Silk Touch drops 8 obsidian and does not lose the items
text.zh_cn: 不使用精准采集破坏时掉落8个黑曜石，箱内物品不会丢失

text.en_us: Cannot be pushed by pistons
text.zh_cn: 无法被活塞推动

text.en_us: Portable storage that keeps its contents when broken
text.zh_cn: 便携存储方块，破坏后物品仍保留在盒中

text.en_us: Cannot be placed inside another shulker box
text.zh_cn: 无法放入另一个潜影盒中

text.en_us: Destroyed by an explosion, it drops itself together with its contents
text.zh_cn: 被爆炸摧毁时会连同其中的物品一起掉落

text.en_us: Its appearance is set by the 4 pottery sherds or bricks used to craft it
text.zh_cn: 由合成时使用的4个陶片或红砖决定外观

text.en_us: Holds a single stack of items
text.zh_cn: 只能存放一组物品

text.en_us: Its contents drop when it is broken
text.zh_cn: 破坏时其中的物品会掉落

text.en_us: Ring it to send nearby villagers running home
text.zh_cn: 敲响后附近的村民会跑回家中

text.en_us: Can be rung by hand or hit by a projectile
text.zh_cn: 可用手敲响，也可被弹射物击中而响

text.en_us: Ringing during a raid makes nearby raiders glow
text.zh_cn: 袭击期间敲响钟会使附近的袭击者发光

text.en_us: Must hang from the bottom or side of a block and cannot be activated by redstone
text.zh_cn: 需悬挂在方块底部或侧面，无法被红石激活

text.en_us: Climbable, and building starts by right-clicking the side of a block
text.zh_cn: 可以攀爬，右键方块的侧面即可开始搭建

text.en_us: Breaking the bottom block breaks everything above it
text.zh_cn: 破坏最下方的一格会使上方全部一并破坏

text.en_us: Sideways placement is limited to a few blocks from a support
text.zh_cn: 向侧面放置时存在水平距离限制

text.en_us: Climbable when attached to a solid block
text.zh_cn: 附着在固体方块上时可以攀爬

text.en_us: Needs a supporting block behind it
text.zh_cn: 背后必须有支撑方块

text.en_us: Breaks and drops if that supporting block is removed
text.zh_cn: 支撑方块被破坏时梯子也会掉落

text.en_us: Climbable when hanging vertically
text.zh_cn: 垂直悬挂时可以攀爬

text.en_us: Can be waterlogged
text.zh_cn: 可以被水浸没

text.en_us: Also used to hang lanterns and bells
text.zh_cn: 也可用于悬挂灯笼与钟

text.en_us: Absorbs nearby water and turns into a wet sponge
text.zh_cn: 吸收周围的水，自身变为湿海绵

text.en_us: Generates only in ocean monuments
text.zh_cn: 仅生成于海底神殿

text.en_us: Cannot absorb water in the Nether, where water evaporates
text.zh_cn: 在下界无法吸水，水会立即蒸发

text.en_us: A waterlogged sponge that drips water particles
text.zh_cn: 吸满水的海绵，会不断滴落水珠

text.en_us: Smelt it in a furnace to turn it back into a sponge
text.zh_cn: 放入熔炉烧炼可变回海绵

text.en_us: Dries instantly when placed in the Nether
text.zh_cn: 放置在下界时会立即变干

text.en_us: Lit with flint and steel or a fire charge
text.zh_cn: 可用打火石或火焰弹点燃

text.en_us: Up to 4 candles of the same color can be placed on one block
text.zh_cn: 同一方块上最多放置4根同色蜡烛

text.en_us: Light level rises with the number of candles: 3, 6, 9 or 12
text.zh_cn: 光照强度随蜡烛数量提升：3、6、9、12

text.en_us: Water or a thrown potion extinguishes it
text.zh_cn: 水或投掷的药水可将其熄灭

text.en_us: A candle can also be placed on top of a cake
text.zh_cn: 也可放置在蛋糕上

text.en_us: A minecart with a hopper that collects items it passes over
text.zh_cn: 装有漏斗的矿车，会拾取经过的物品

text.en_us: Inserts collected items into containers it rolls into
text.zh_cn: 会将收集的物品存入沿途的容器

text.en_us: Also pulls items from a container directly above it
text.zh_cn: 也可从正上方的容器中抽取物品

text.en_us: An activator rail stops it from collecting and transferring items
text.zh_cn: 驶过激活铁轨时会停止收集与传输物品

text.en_us: Build a Nether portal frame out of obsidian and light the interior with flint and steel
text.zh_cn: 用黑曜石搭建下界传送门框架，再用打火石点燃内部

text.en_us: Mined only with a diamond or netherite pickaxe
text.zh_cn: 只能使用钻石镐或下界合金镐开采

text.en_us: Blast resistant and immune to piston movement and to being pushed by the Ender Dragon
text.zh_cn: 具有爆炸抗性，无法被活塞推动，也不会被末影龙破坏

text.en_us: Created where flowing water meets a lava source block
text.zh_cn: 流动的水接触熔岩源方块时生成

text.en_us: Nether portal frame:
text.zh_cn: 下界传送门框架：

text.en_us: A purple-glowing obsidian variant that emits purple particles
text.zh_cn: 会持续散发紫色粒子的黑曜石变种

text.en_us: Used to craft a Respawn Anchor
text.zh_cn: 用于合成重生锚

text.en_us: Cannot be used to build a Nether portal
text.zh_cn: 不能用于搭建下界传送门

text.en_us: Can be mined with a diamond or netherite pickaxe
text.zh_cn: 可使用钻石镐或下界合金镐开采

text.en_us: Fires a beam into the sky and grants powers when placed on a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks
text.zh_cn: 放置于铁块、金块、钻石块、绿宝石块或下界合金块构成的金字塔上时，向天空发射光束并给予效果

text.en_us: The pyramid supports 1 to 4 layers: more layers grant a stronger power and a wider range
text.zh_cn: 金字塔可搭建 1 至 4 层，层数越多，效果越强、作用范围越大

text.en_us: Right-click the beacon to choose a primary power, which is granted to nearby players
text.zh_cn: 右键信标可选择主要效果，附近玩家会获得该效果

text.en_us: Needs a clear view of the sky above it to project its beam
text.zh_cn: 上方需要能直接看到天空，否则无法投射光束

text.en_us: A 4-layer pyramid unlocks a second power
text.zh_cn: 搭建 4 层金字塔后可再选择一项次要效果

text.en_us: Stained glass placed above the beacon recolours the beam
text.zh_cn: 在信标上方放置染色玻璃可改变光束颜色

text.en_us: Beacon pyramid:
text.zh_cn: 信标金字塔：

text.en_us: A conduit activated by a frame of prismarine blocks in water grants Conduit Power to nearby players
text.zh_cn: 在水中被海晶石框架激活后，为附近玩家提供潮涌能量

text.en_us: Conduit Power grants water breathing, night vision and haste
text.zh_cn: 潮涌能量提供水下呼吸、夜视与急迫效果

text.en_us: The frame may also be built from dark prismarine and sea lanterns; no two frame blocks may be adjacent
text.zh_cn: 框架也可使用暗海晶石与海晶灯，且任意两个框架方块不能相邻

text.en_us: The effect radius grows with the size of the frame, up to 96 blocks
text.zh_cn: 框架越大，效果半径越大，最大 96 格

text.en_us: Attacks hostile mobs in contact with water within 8 blocks
text.zh_cn: 攻击 8 格内接触水的敌对生物

text.en_us: Conduit frame:
text.zh_cn: 潮涌核心框架：

text.en_us: Charge with glowstone to set your spawn in the Nether
text.zh_cn: 装填荧石以设置在下界的重生点

text.en_us: Holds up to 4 charges; each respawn consumes one charge
text.zh_cn: 最多可装填 4 次，每次重生消耗 1 次充能

text.en_us: Using it in the Overworld or the End causes an explosion
text.zh_cn: 在主世界或末地使用时会引发爆炸

text.en_us: Right-click with glowstone to add a charge
text.zh_cn: 手持荧石右键可添加一次充能

text.en_us: An explosion triggered by using an uncharged anchor in the Overworld or the End destroys nearby blocks
text.zh_cn: 在无充能状态下于主世界或末地使用，爆炸会破坏周围方块

text.en_us: Right-click with a compass to bind that compass to this lodestone
text.zh_cn: 手持指南针右键可将其绑定到该磁石

text.en_us: A bound compass always points to this lodestone, even across dimensions
text.zh_cn: 绑定的指南针始终指向该磁石，跨维度依然有效

text.en_us: A lodestone compass cannot be re-bound to another lodestone
text.zh_cn: 已绑定的磁石指南针无法重新绑定到其他磁石

text.en_us: Can be mined with any pickaxe and keeps its binding
text.zh_cn: 可使用任意镐开采，破坏后仍保留原有绑定

text.en_us: Fire placed on netherrack burns forever
text.zh_cn: 在其上方点燃的火焰会永久燃烧

text.en_us: Can be lit with flint and steel or a fire charge
text.zh_cn: 可用打火石或火焰弹点燃

text.en_us: Mined with any pickaxe
text.zh_cn: 可使用任意镐开采

text.en_us: Fire on soul soil becomes soul fire, which burns forever and deals more damage than normal fire
text.zh_cn: 在其上方点燃的火焰会变成灵魂火，永久燃烧且伤害高于普通火焰

text.en_us: Used with soul sand to summon the Wither
text.zh_cn: 与灵魂沙一同用于召唤凋灵

text.en_us: Does not slow entities that walk on it
text.zh_cn: 不会减慢走在其上方的实体

text.en_us: The Soul Speed enchantment works when walking on it
text.zh_cn: 在其上行走时灵魂疾行附魔生效

text.zh_cn: 与灵魂土一同用于召唤凋灵

text.zh_cn: 在其上行走时灵魂疾行附魔生效

text.en_us: Slows entities that move through it
text.zh_cn: 减慢在其中移动的实体

text.en_us: Mined with shears or a sword to drop a cobweb
text.zh_cn: 使用剪刀或剑破坏时掉落蜘蛛网

text.en_us: Breaking it with any other tool drops string
text.zh_cn: 使用其他工具破坏时掉落线

text.en_us: Place 3 wither skeleton skulls on top of a T of soul sand or soul soil to summon the Wither
text.zh_cn: 将 3 个凋灵骷髅头颅放置在灵魂沙或灵魂土构成的 T 形结构上方，即可召唤凋灵

text.en_us: Dropped by wither skeletons
text.zh_cn: 由凋灵骷髅掉落

text.en_us: Can be worn on the head
text.zh_cn: 可以戴在头上

text.zh_cn: 召唤结构：

text.zh_cn: 戴在头上时末影人不会变为敌对

text.en_us: Made by using shears on a pumpkin
text.zh_cn: 对南瓜使用剪刀可获得

text.en_us: Placed above iron blocks it summons an Iron Golem; above snow blocks it summons a Snow Golem
text.zh_cn: 放置在铁块上方可召唤铁傀儡，放置在雪块上方可召唤雪傀儡

text.en_us: Can be carved into a carved pumpkin by using shears on it
text.zh_cn: 对南瓜使用剪刀可将其雕刻为雕刻南瓜

text.en_us: A plain pumpkin cannot be worn
text.zh_cn: 普通南瓜不能戴在头上

text.en_us: Placed on an obsidian pillar or on bedrock, it heals the Ender Dragon
text.zh_cn: 放置在黑曜石柱或基岩上时，会为末影龙恢复生命

text.en_us: Placing all four crystals respawns the Ender Dragon
text.zh_cn: 放齐 4 个末地水晶可重新召唤末影龙

text.en_us: Explodes when hit, dealing heavy damage to everything nearby
text.zh_cn: 被击中时爆炸，对周围造成大量伤害

text.en_us: Cannot be obtained in survival
text.zh_cn: 生存模式下无法获得

text.en_us: Placement:
text.zh_cn: 放置方式：

text.en_us: The trophy dropped when the Ender Dragon is defeated
text.zh_cn: 击败末影龙后掉落的战利品

text.en_us: Teleports away when you try to mine or touch it
text.zh_cn: 尝试开采或接触时会传送离开

text.en_us: Can be moved with a piston
text.zh_cn: 可使用活塞移动

text.en_us: Spawns mobs of its stored type in a radius while a player is within 16 blocks
text.zh_cn: 当玩家位于 16 格范围内时，在其周围生成所存储类型的生物

text.en_us: The spawning radius shrinks as more mobs of that type are nearby
text.zh_cn: 附近同类生物越多，生成半径越小

text.en_us: Can be disabled by placing a torch on it or by keeping the area lit
text.zh_cn: 在其上放置火把或保持区域明亮可阻止刷怪

text.en_us: Cannot be obtained even with Silk Touch; spawn eggs are used to change its stored mob
text.zh_cn: 即使使用精准采集也无法获得，需用刷怪蛋改变其存储的生物

text.en_us: 12 frames form a ring; right-click a frame with an Eye of Ender to fill it
text.zh_cn: 12 个框架围成一圈，手持末影之眼右键可将其填入框架

text.en_us: Filling all 12 frames opens the End portal
text.zh_cn: 填满 12 个框架后末地传送门开启

text.en_us: Some frames generate in strongholds already filled
text.zh_cn: 要塞中生成的框架有一部分已预填末影之眼

text.en_us: A frame with an eye cannot be mined without breaking it, and never drops the eye
text.zh_cn: 已填眼的框架被破坏时不会掉落末影之眼

text.en_us: Portal ring:
text.zh_cn: 传送门环：

text.en_us: A decorative trophy head that can be worn
text.zh_cn: 可穿戴的装饰性战利品头颅

text.en_us: Opens and closes its jaw when powered by redstone
text.zh_cn: 被红石信号激活时上下开合下颚

text.en_us: Does not prevent endermen from becoming hostile
text.zh_cn: 无法阻止末影人变为敌对

text.en_us: Generates naturally in the End
text.zh_cn: 自然生成于末地

text.en_us: Can be crafted into end stone bricks
text.zh_cn: 可用于合成末地石砖

text.en_us: Blast resistant
text.zh_cn: 具有爆炸抗性

text.en_us: Laid by turtles on sand
text.zh_cn: 由海龟产在沙子上

text.en_us: Hatches into baby turtles if left alone
text.zh_cn: 不被干扰时会孵化出海龟幼崽

text.en_us: Can be trampled and destroyed by mobs stepping on it
text.zh_cn: 被生物踩踏时会破碎

text.en_us: Silk Touch is required to pick it up
text.zh_cn: 需要精准采集才能将其采集

text.en_us: Hatches into a Sniffer after cracking through 3 stages
text.zh_cn: 经过 3 个阶段的裂纹后孵化出嗅探兽

text.en_us: Found in suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins
text.zh_cn: 生成于暖水海洋废墟的可疑的沙子中

text.en_us: Hatches faster on moss blocks
text.zh_cn: 放置在苔藓块上时孵化更快

text.zh_cn: 常见于天空村庄中的教堂、下界塔的天桥下

text.en_us: Light the interior of an obsidian frame with flint and steel or a fire charge
text.zh_cn: 用打火石或火焰弹点燃黑曜石框架的内部

text.en_us: The smallest frame is 4x5 (a 2x3 interior); the largest is 23x23
text.zh_cn: 最小框架为 4x5（内部 2x3），最大为 23x23

text.en_us: Entering it travels between the Overworld and the Nether
text.zh_cn: 进入后可在主世界与下界之间往返

text.en_us: The portal stays lit once created
text.zh_cn: 传送门生成后会一直保持开启

text.en_us: Portal blocks cannot be obtained as an item
text.zh_cn: 传送门方块无法作为物品获得

text.en_us: Appears when all 12 End portal frames are filled with Eyes of Ender
text.zh_cn: 填满 12 个末地传送门框架后出现

text.en_us: Touching the portal block teleports you to the End
text.zh_cn: 接触传送门方块会传送至末地

text.en_us: The portal block cannot be obtained or destroyed
text.zh_cn: 传送门方块无法获得，也无法破坏

text.en_us: Right-click to throw; teleports you to where it lands
text.zh_cn: 右键投掷，将你传送至落点

text.en_us: The teleport deals 5 fall damage on arrival
text.zh_cn: 传送落地时受到5点摔落伤害

text.en_us: Also used to craft Eyes of Ender
text.zh_cn: 亦可用于合成末影之眼

text.en_us: Right-click to throw; it flies toward the nearest Stronghold and then drops
text.zh_cn: 右键投掷，飞向最近的要塞后掉落

text.en_us: Has a 20% chance to shatter instead of dropping
text.zh_cn: 有20%的概率在飞行途中破碎

text.zh_cn: 用于填充末地传送门框架

text.en_us: Points to the world spawn point
text.zh_cn: 指向世界出生点

text.en_us: Can be bound to a Lodestone to point at it instead
text.zh_cn: 可与磁石绑定，改为指向该磁石

text.en_us: Spins randomly in the Nether and the End
text.zh_cn: 在下界、末地中指针随机旋转

text.en_us: Points to the place where you last died
text.zh_cn: 指向你上次死亡的位置

text.zh_cn: 从未死亡或死亡点位于其他维度时随机旋转

text.en_us: Found in Ancient City chests
text.zh_cn: 生成于远古城市的箱子中

text.en_us: Shows the time of day, but only while held in hand
text.zh_cn: 显示当前时间，仅在手持时生效

text.en_us: Does not work in the Nether or the End
text.zh_cn: 在下界、末地中无法正常工作

text.en_us: Right-click suspicious sand or gravel to brush it and reveal an archaeology item
text.zh_cn: 右键可疑的沙子或沙砾进行刷扫，以取出考古物品

text.en_us: Also brushes an armadillo to obtain scutes
text.zh_cn: 亦可用于刷扫犰狳以获取犰狳鳞甲

text.en_us: Takes durability damage with each use
text.zh_cn: 每次使用消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Right-click and hold to zoom in on a distant view
text.zh_cn: 右键按住以放大远处视野

text.en_us: Narrows the field of view and slows your movement while in use
text.zh_cn: 使用时视野收窄，移动速度降低

text.en_us: Crafted from an amethyst shard and copper ingots
text.zh_cn: 由紫水晶碎片与铜锭合成

text.en_us: Holds a single stack's worth of mixed items, weighing up to 64 items in total
text.zh_cn: 可装入总计一组即最多64个物品的混合物

text.en_us: Right-click to insert all matching items; sneak and right-click to take the last one out
text.zh_cn: 右键存入物品，潜行右键取出最后一个物品

text.en_us: Shulker boxes cannot be placed inside
text.zh_cn: 无法装入潜影盒

text.en_us: Double-tap the jump key in midair to start gliding; equips in the chestplate slot
text.zh_cn: 空中双击跳跃键开始滑翔，装备于胸甲栏

text.en_us: Firework rockets give you height and speed
text.zh_cn: 使用烟花火箭可获得高度与速度

text.en_us: Wears down over time as you fly
text.zh_cn: 飞行过程中会持续消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Right-click to throw it; it drops where it lands and can be picked up again
text.zh_cn: 右键投掷，落在何处便掉落在何处且可拾回

text.en_us: Loyalty makes a thrown trident fly back to you
text.zh_cn: 附魔忠诚的投掷三叉戟会飞回手中

text.en_us: Riptide launches you forward in water or rain; Channeling summons lightning on a hit during a thunderstorm
text.zh_cn: 激流在雨中或水中将你向前推进，引雷在雷暴中命中时召唤闪电

text.en_us: Right-click to blow it and play its sound
text.zh_cn: 右键吹响山羊角

text.en_us: There are 8 sounds in total and each horn keeps one fixed sound
text.zh_cn: 共有8种音色，每一只山羊角的音色固定

text.en_us: Dropped by a goat that rams into certain blocks
text.zh_cn: 山羊撞击特定方块时掉落

text.en_us: Right-click a mob to give it a name
text.zh_cn: 右键生物为其命名

text.en_us: A named mob keeps its name and no longer despawns
text.zh_cn: 被命名的生物保留名字且不再消失

text.en_us: Not craftable; found in loot chests, by fishing, or from villager trades. Use it again to rename the mob
text.zh_cn: 无法合成，仅来自战利品箱、钓鱼或村民交易；再次使用可改名

text.en_us: Right-click a mob to tie it to you, then right-click a fence post to bind it there
text.zh_cn: 右键生物将其拴住，再右键栅栏柱拴在其上

text.en_us: Right-clicking a tied fence post pulls the mob toward it
text.zh_cn: 右键已拴住的栅栏柱可将生物拉向该处

text.en_us: Snaps if the distance grows too great
text.zh_cn: 距离过远时拴绳会断裂

text.en_us: Right-click a horse, donkey, mule, pig, strider or camel to ride it bare-handed
text.zh_cn: 右键马、驴、骡、猪、炽足兽或骆驼即可骑乘

text.en_us: Not craftable; found in dungeon loot and from villager trades
text.zh_cn: 无法合成，来自地牢战利品与村民交易

text.en_us: Right-click a sheep to shear its wool
text.zh_cn: 右键羊以剪取羊毛

text.en_us: Use it on a full beehive for honeycomb, cut cave vines, and break cobwebs and leaves quickly
text.zh_cn: 对装满的蜂巢使用可获取蜜脾，亦可剪断洞穴藤蔓，并快速破坏蜘蛛网与树叶

text.en_us: Each use costs durability
text.zh_cn: 每次使用消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Right-click a block to start a fire on its face
text.zh_cn: 右键方块在其表面点火

text.en_us: Lights a Nether portal and primes TNT
text.zh_cn: 可点燃下界传送门，也可引爆TNT

text.en_us: Costs durability on every use
text.zh_cn: 每次使用消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Right-click a fluid source block to fill it
text.zh_cn: 右键流体源方块将其装填

text.en_us: Right-click a cow or mooshroom with an empty bucket to get milk
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键牛或哞菇可获取牛奶

text.en_us: Flowing fluid cannot be picked up
text.zh_cn: 无法装取流动的流体

text.en_us: Can be transmuted in Shimmer
text.zh_cn: 可微光嬗变

text.en_us: Right-click a block to place a water source
text.zh_cn: 右键方块放置水源

text.en_us: The placed water can be used to break a fall
text.zh_cn: 放置的水可用于缓冲摔落

text.en_us: Can fill a cauldron; water cannot be placed in the Nether
text.zh_cn: 可倒入炼药锅；下界中无法放置水

text.en_us: Can be transmuted in Shimmer
text.zh_cn: 可微光嬗变

text.en_us: Right-click a block to place a lava source
text.zh_cn: 右键方块放置岩浆源

text.en_us: Burns in a furnace as fuel for a very long time
text.zh_cn: 可在熔炉中作为燃料，燃烧时间极长

text.en_us: Can be poured into a cauldron
text.zh_cn: 可倒入炼药锅

text.en_us: Drink it to remove every status effect, harmful ones included
text.zh_cn: 饮用后移除全部状态效果，包括负面效果

text.en_us: One of the ingredients of a Cake
text.zh_cn: 是合成蛋糕的材料之一

text.en_us: Right-click a block to place powder snow
text.zh_cn: 右键方块放置细雪

text.en_us: Wearing leather boots lets you walk on top of powder snow instead of sinking in
text.zh_cn: 穿着皮革靴子可在细雪上行走而不下陷

text.en_us: Can be poured into a cauldron
text.zh_cn: 可倒入炼药锅

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch an axolotl
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉美西螈

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: The bucket stores the axolotl's colour variant
text.zh_cn: 桶中保留美西螈的变种颜色

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch a cod
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉鳕鱼

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch a salmon
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉鲑鱼

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch a pufferfish
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉河豚

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch a tropical fish
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉热带鱼

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: The bucket stores the fish's variant and pattern
text.zh_cn: 桶中保留热带鱼的变种与花纹

text.en_us: Right-click water with an empty bucket to catch a tadpole
text.zh_cn: 手持空桶右键水面捕捉蝌蚪

text.en_us: Right-click a block to release it
text.zh_cn: 右键方块将其放出

text.en_us: A released tadpole grows into a frog
text.zh_cn: 放出的蝌蚪会成长为青蛙

text.en_us: Drink it to restore hunger and cure Poison
text.zh_cn: 饮用后恢复饥饿值并解除中毒

text.en_us: Obtained by using a glass bottle on a full beehive
text.zh_cn: 手持玻璃瓶对装满的蜂巢使用获得

text.en_us: Drinking it leaves an empty glass bottle
text.zh_cn: 饮用后返还一个空玻璃瓶

text.en_us: Right-click water to fill it into a Water Bottle
text.zh_cn: 右键水面装填为水瓶

text.en_us: Use it on a full beehive for a Honey Bottle, or on a dragon's breath cloud for Dragon's Breath
text.zh_cn: 对装满的蜂巢使用可得蜂蜜瓶，对龙息云使用可得龙息

text.en_us: The base container for brewing potions
text.zh_cn: 是酿造药水的基础容器

text.en_us: Held in the main hand or offhand, it is consumed instead of letting you die
text.zh_cn: 持于主手或副手时，在你将死亡时被消耗以代替死亡

text.en_us: Restores health and grants Absorption and Regeneration
text.zh_cn: 恢复生命值并给予伤害吸收与生命恢复

text.en_us: Dropped by Evokers
text.zh_cn: 由唤魔者掉落

text.en_us: Left behind as a cloud by the Ender Dragon's breath attack
text.zh_cn: 由末影龙的龙息攻击留下成云

text.en_us: Collect it with a glass bottle
text.zh_cn: 用玻璃瓶收集

text.en_us: Used to brew Lingering Potions
text.zh_cn: 用于酿造滞留药水

text.en_us: Eat it to restore hunger and grant Absorption and Regeneration for a short time
text.zh_cn: 食用后恢复饥饿值，并短时间内给予伤害吸收与生命恢复

text.en_us: Combined with a Weakness potion, it cures a zombie villager
text.zh_cn: 配合虚弱药水可治愈僵尸村民

text.en_us: Grants Absorption, Regeneration and Fire Resistance for far longer than a golden apple
text.zh_cn: 给予伤害吸收、生命恢复与防火，持续时间远长于金苹果

text.en_us: Cannot be crafted; only found in loot chests
text.zh_cn: 无法合成，仅生成于战利品箱中

text.en_us: Eat it to teleport a short distance in a random direction
text.zh_cn: 食用后会向随机方向短距离传送

text.en_us: Can be eaten even when your hunger bar is full
text.zh_cn: 饥饿值已满时仍可食用

text.en_us: Smelt it into Popped Chorus Fruit
text.zh_cn: 烧炼后得到爆裂紫颂果

text.en_us: Eat it to restore a little hunger
text.zh_cn: 食用后恢复少量饥饿值

text.en_us: Has a high chance to inflict Hunger
text.zh_cn: 有较高概率获得饥饿效果

text.en_us: Eat it to restore hunger, but it inflicts Poison
text.zh_cn: 食用后恢复饥饿值，但会造成中毒

text.en_us: Crafted into a Fermented Spider Eye
text.zh_cn: 用于合成发酵蛛眼

text.en_us: Eat it to restore hunger, but it inflicts Hunger, Poison and Nausea
text.zh_cn: 食用后恢复饥饿值，但会造成饥饿、中毒与反胃

text.en_us: Used to brew Potions of Water Breathing
text.zh_cn: 用于酿造水肺药水

text.en_us: Grants one random status effect that depends on the flower used to make it
text.zh_cn: 给予一种随所用花而定的随机状态效果

text.en_us: The tooltip does not reveal the effect until you eat it
text.zh_cn: 食用前提示框不会显示该效果

text.en_us: Found in loot chests, or crafted from a bowl, a brown mushroom, a red mushroom and a flower
text.zh_cn: 来自战利品箱，或用碗、棕色蘑菇、红色蘑菇与一朵花合成

text.en_us: Dropped by the Wither
text.zh_cn: 由凋灵掉落

text.en_us: Used to craft a Beacon, and is consumed in the recipe
text.zh_cn: 用于合成信标，且合成时会被消耗

text.en_us: Right-click to unlock the recipes stored inside it
text.zh_cn: 右键以解锁其中记录的配方

text.en_us: Only obtainable with commands
text.zh_cn: 仅能通过命令获取

text.en_us: Right-click to write and sign a book of at most 50 pages
text.zh_cn: 右键撰写并署名，最多50页

text.en_us: Signing turns it into a Written Book and locks the text
text.zh_cn: 署名后变为成书，文字无法再修改

text.en_us: Can be copied by combining it with a Book and Quill
text.zh_cn: 与书与笔一同放入合成栏可复制

text.en_us: Its text cannot be edited
text.zh_cn: 其文字无法编辑

text.en_us: Stacks only when the copies are identical
text.zh_cn: 仅内容完全相同的成书可以堆叠

text.en_us: Right-click to activate it and record the area around you
text.zh_cn: 右键激活，并记录你周围的区域

text.en_us: The map fills in as you travel
text.zh_cn: 随着探索逐步绘制出地形

text.en_us: Can be copied, zoomed out or locked on a Cartography Table
text.zh_cn: 可在制图台中复制、缩小比例或锁定

text.en_us: A locked map can no longer be edited, and maps can be placed in item frames
text.zh_cn: 锁定后的地图无法再被修改，地图可放入物品展示框

text.en_us: Hold it in the offhand and sneak to block melee and projectile damage from the front
text.zh_cn: 持于副手并潜行，可格挡来自正面的近战与弹射物伤害

text.en_us: Blocking slows your movement, and an axe hit disables the shield for a short time
text.zh_cn: 格挡时移动速度降低，被斧击中会暂时失效

text.en_us: A banner can be applied to it to display a pattern
text.zh_cn: 可附加旗帜以显示图案

text.en_us: Worn as a helmet; crafted from scutes
text.zh_cn: 作为头盔穿戴，由鳞甲合成

text.en_us: Grants Water Breathing for 10 seconds while underwater and extends how long you can hold your breath
text.zh_cn: 在水下给予10秒水下呼吸，并延长可屏息的时间

text.en_us: The payload of a Firework Rocket
text.zh_cn: 是烟花火箭的载荷

text.en_us: Dyes and extra ingredients set its shape, colours, fade colours and twinkle
text.zh_cn: 所用染料与附加材料决定其形状、颜色、褪色与闪烁

text.en_us: A rocket made with firework stars can also damage entities
text.zh_cn: 装有烟花之星的火箭可对生物造成伤害

text.en_us: Right-click to throw; it shatters and releases experience orbs
text.zh_cn: 右键投掷，破碎后释放经验球

text.en_us: The orbs must be collected before they disappear
text.zh_cn: 需在经验球消失前拾取

text.en_us: Obtained from villager trades and loot chests
text.zh_cn: 来自村民交易与战利品箱

text.en_us: Note: Also crafted at the Fletching Table
text.zh_cn: 注：制箭台亦可用于制作箭矢

text.en_us: Standard ammunition for bows, crossbows and dispensers
text.zh_cn: 是弓、弩与发射器的标准弹药

text.en_us: Can be tipped with a potion to carry its effect
text.zh_cn: 可用药水制成药箭以附加效果

text.en_us: Crafted from glowstone dust
text.zh_cn: 由荧石粉合成

text.en_us: Marks the entity it hits with a glowing outline, visible through blocks
text.zh_cn: 命中后使目标带有发光轮廓，可穿透方块看见

text.en_us: In Java Edition it can only be obtained by crafting
text.zh_cn: 在Java版中仅能通过合成获得

text.en_us: An arrow carrying a potion effect; crafted from arrows and a Lingering Potion
text.zh_cn: 带有药水效果的箭，由箭与滞留药水合成

text.en_us: The effect lasts one eighth as long as the potion's own duration
text.zh_cn: 效果持续时间为对应药水的八分之一

text.en_us: Obtained by shearing a full beehive or bee nest
text.zh_cn: 用剪刀剪取装满的蜂巢或蜂箱获得

text.en_us: Used to wax copper blocks so they stop oxidizing
text.zh_cn: 用于给铜块打蜡以停止氧化

text.en_us: Also crafts Candles and Bee Nests
text.zh_cn: 亦可用于合成蜡烛与蜂箱

text.en_us: Right-click a sign to make its text glow
text.zh_cn: 右键告示牌使其文字发光

text.en_us: Also crafts Glow Item Frames
text.zh_cn: 亦可用于合成荧光物品展示框

text.en_us: Dropped by glow squid
text.zh_cn: 由发光鱿鱼掉落

text.en_us: Right-click a glowing sign to remove its glow
text.zh_cn: 右键发光的告示牌可去除其发光

text.en_us: Also used as a black dye
text.zh_cn: 亦可用作黑色染料

text.en_us: Dropped by squid
text.zh_cn: 由鱿鱼掉落

text.en_us: Right-click a plant to instantly grow it one stage
text.zh_cn: 右键植物使其立即生长一个阶段

text.en_us: Right-click a grass block to grow grass and flowers on nearby blocks
text.zh_cn: 右键草方块使附近的方块长出草与花

text.en_us: Crafted from bones and bone blocks; also makes white dye
text.zh_cn: 由骨头与骨块合成，亦可制成白色染料

text.en_us: Plant on farmland to grow wheat
text.zh_cn: 种植在耕地上以长出小麦

text.en_us: Used to breed and lead chickens
text.zh_cn: 用于繁殖与牵引鸡

text.en_us: Fed to a baby chicken to speed up its growth
text.zh_cn: 喂给幼年鸡可加速其成长

text.en_us: Right-click a saddled pig to ride it and steer it
text.zh_cn: 右键已装鞍的猪即可骑乘并控制方向

text.en_us: Crafted with a fishing rod and a carrot
text.zh_cn: 由钓鱼竿与胡萝卜合成

text.en_us: Takes durability damage as you ride
text.zh_cn: 骑乘过程中会消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Right-click a saddled Strider to ride it across lava and steer it
text.zh_cn: 右键已装鞍的炽足兽即可在岩浆上骑乘并控制方向

text.en_us: Takes durability damage as you ride
text.zh_cn: 骑乘过程中会消耗耐久度

text.en_us: Found in Ancient City chests
text.zh_cn: 生成于远古城市的箱子中

text.en_us: Used to craft a Recovery Compass
text.zh_cn: 用于合成回溯指南针

text.en_us: Nine fragments combine into one Music Disc 5
text.zh_cn: 9个碎片可合成1张音乐唱片5

text.en_us: Found in Ancient City chests
text.zh_cn: 生成于远古城市的箱子中

text.en_us: Found in buried treasure chests
text.zh_cn: 生成于埋藏的宝藏箱子中

text.en_us: Combined with nautilus shells to craft a Conduit
text.zh_cn: 与鹦鹉螺壳一同合成潮涌核心

text.en_us: Dropped by drowned holding one, and caught by fishing
text.zh_cn: 由手持鹦鹉螺壳的溺尸掉落，亦可钓得

text.en_us: Eight of them with a Heart of the Sea craft a Conduit
text.zh_cn: 8个鹦鹉螺壳与1个海洋之心可合成潮涌核心

text.en_us: Can be refined
text.zh_cn: 可提炼

text.en_us: Naturally generates on the surface and in Living Trees
text.zh_cn: 自然生成于地表和生命树中

text.en_us: Can be transmuted in Shimmer into Ambrosia
text.zh_cn: 可微光嬗变为仙馔密酒

text.en_us: Can be transmuted in Shimmer into Shimmer Arrow
text.zh_cn: 可微光嬗变为微光箭

text.en_us: Can be transmuted in Shimmer
text.zh_cn: 可微光嬗变

text.en_us: Right-click during the day to set your respawn point
text.zh_cn: 白天右键可设置重生点

text.en_us: Right-click at night to sleep and skip to morning
text.zh_cn: 夜晚右键可睡觉并直接跳到清晨

text.en_us: Using a bed in the Nether or the End causes an explosion
text.zh_cn: 在下界或末地使用床会引发爆炸

text.en_us: Nearby hostile mobs prevent sleeping
text.zh_cn: 附近存在敌对生物时无法入睡

text.en_us: A thunderstorm lets you sleep during the day
text.zh_cn: 雷暴天气下白天也可以睡觉

text.en_us: Emits a 1-second pulse, 10 redstone ticks, when pressed by hand
text.zh_cn: 被手按下时输出 1 秒即 10 红石刻的脉冲

text.en_us: Hit by an arrow, it emits a longer pulse
text.zh_cn: 被箭射中时输出更长的脉冲

text.en_us: Can be placed on the floor, ceiling or a wall
text.zh_cn: 可放置在地面、天花板或墙面上

text.en_us: Arrows fired by a dispenser also press it
text.zh_cn: 发射器射出的箭也能按下它

text.en_us: Emits power of strength 15 while any entity stands on it
text.zh_cn: 有实体踩在其上时输出强度 15 的红石信号

text.en_us: Dropped items also trigger a wooden pressure plate, unlike a stone one
text.zh_cn: 与石质压力板不同，掉落的物品也会触发木质压力板

text.en_us: Also triggered by arrows and other projectiles
text.zh_cn: 也会被箭等弹射物触发

text.en_us: A stalactite on a ceiling drips water or lava into the cauldron below
text.zh_cn: 天花板上的钟乳石会向下方炼药锅滴入水或熔岩

text.en_us: Falling on a stalactite hurts; standing on a stalagmite hurts more
text.zh_cn: 落在钟乳石上会受到伤害，踩在石笋上伤害更高

text.en_us: Can be waterlogged and is placed on any face
text.zh_cn: 可以含水，可附着在任意面上

text.en_us: Entities sink into it unless they wear leather boots
text.zh_cn: 未穿皮革靴子的实体会陷进去

text.en_us: Entities inside gradually freeze, taking freeze damage
text.zh_cn: 陷在其中的实体会逐渐冻结并受到冰冻伤害

text.en_us: Breaks your fall, and can be collected with a bucket
text.zh_cn: 可以缓冲摔落伤害，可用桶收集

text.en_us: Falls away if you break the block below it
text.zh_cn: 破坏其下方的方块时会整块塌落

text.en_us: Stays tilted up while you stand on it, then tilts down and drops you
text.zh_cn: 站上去时会先保持抬起，随后倾斜并使你掉落

text.en_us: A redstone signal locks it in the up position
text.zh_cn: 接收红石信号时会保持抬起状态

text.en_us: Bone meal makes it grow taller
text.zh_cn: 使用骨粉可使其长高

text.en_us: Grows from the underside of dirt and grass blocks in Lush Caves
text.zh_cn: 生长在繁茂洞穴中泥土与草方块的下表面

text.en_us: Can be climbed like a ladder
text.zh_cn: 可以像梯子一样攀爬

text.en_us: Grows downward from the ceiling in Lush Caves
text.zh_cn: 在繁茂洞穴中从天花板向下生长

text.en_us: Can be climbed like a ladder, and bears glow berries
text.zh_cn: 可以像梯子一样攀爬，并结有发光浆果

text.en_us: Bone meal and glow berries make it grow further
text.zh_cn: 使用骨粉或发光浆果可使其继续生长

text.en_us: Right-click an empty frame with an item to display it
text.zh_cn: 手持物品右键空展示框即可将其展示出来

text.en_us: Right-click with a map to show a map on a wall
text.zh_cn: 手持地图右键可将地图挂在墙上

text.en_us: Rotate the displayed item by right-clicking it again
text.zh_cn: 再次右键展示框内的物品可将其旋转

text.en_us: Like an item frame, but the displayed item stays fully lit
text.zh_cn: 与展示框相同，但展示的物品始终保持全亮

text.en_us: Crafted by combining an item frame with a glow ink sac
text.zh_cn: 由展示框与荧光墨囊合成

text.en_us: Right-click an empty frame with an item to display it
text.zh_cn: 手持物品右键空展示框即可将其展示出来

text.en_us: Right-click with an item to equip it on the stand
text.zh_cn: 手持物品右键可将其装备在盔甲架上

text.en_us: Can be posed by right-clicking its limbs
text.zh_cn: 右键其肢体可以摆出不同姿势

text.en_us: A dispenser can equip armor onto a stand in front of it
text.zh_cn: 发射器可以为正前方的盔甲架装备盔甲

text.en_us: Grows the chorus plant when it receives a block tick
text.zh_cn: 收到方块更新时会使紫颂植物生长

text.en_us: Dies and drops nothing if it cannot grow
text.zh_cn: 无法生长时会枯萎且不掉落任何物品

text.en_us: Can be broken to stop a chorus plant from spreading
text.zh_cn: 破坏它可以阻止紫颂植物继续蔓延

text.en_us: Can be crafted into sticks, scaffolding and bamboo blocks
text.zh_cn: 可合成木棍、脚手架与竹块

text.en_us: A fuel source, and grows very quickly on the surface
text.zh_cn: 可作为燃料，在地表生长极快

text.en_us: Can be smelted into a bamboo block for storage
text.zh_cn: 可烧炼成竹块以便储存
